param: π Human population birth/recruitment rate
k Fraction of human recruitment that is vaccinated (vaccination rate/coverage at recruitment)
μ₁ Natural death rate of humans
θ Rate of vaccine immunity loss (waning / vaccine failure)
ε Vaccine efficacy modifier used in vaccinated-to-vector infection term (breakthrough susceptibility factor in equations)
τ₁ Progression rate from vector-exposed humans (E_H1) to infectious humans (I_H)
τ₂ Progression rate from non-vector-exposed humans (E_H2) to infectious humans (I_H)
σ Progression rate from infectious humans (I_H) to treated humans (T_H)
ω Progression rate from treated humans (T_H) to recovered humans (R_H)
γ Loss of immunity rate in recovered humans (R_H → S_H)
δ₁ Disease-induced death rate for humans (applies in I_H and T_H equations)
Λ Mosquito population birth/recruitment rate (into S_M)
μ₂ Natural death rate of mosquitoes
φ Progression rate from exposed mosquitoes (E_M) to infectious mosquitoes (I_M)
ηᵥ Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infected mosquitoes (used in β₁ definition in paper text)
ηₛ Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infected mosquitoes (used in β₂ definition in paper text)
ξᵥ Effective contact rate of vaccinated humans with infected humans via non-vector pathways (used in α₁ definition in paper text)
ξₛ Effective contact rate of susceptible humans with infected humans via non-vector pathways (used in α₂ definition in paper text)
ρ Effective contact rate of susceptible mosquitoes with infected humans through bloodmeals (used in β₃ definition in paper text)
β₁ Vaccinated-human infection contact term for vector-borne exposure (appears in ODEs as β₁ ε V_H)
β₂ Susceptible-human infection contact term for vector-borne exposure (appears in ODEs as β₂ S_H)
α₁ Vaccinated-human infection contact term for non-vector exposure (appears in ODEs as α₁ V_H)
α₂ Susceptible-human infection contact term for non-vector exposure (appears in ODEs as α₂ S_H)
β₃ Mosquito infection contact term from infectious humans (appears in ODEs as β₃ S_M)
